thread:
julie_cs: heads up — ACME Pay says outputs changed after today's ap-sg canary. Several requests returning malformed/truncated JSON and occasional unrelated product names inserted. sample req: req_0a9c. model: redwood-1.2.4-quant. cluster: ap-sg-01. gpu: A10G.

julie_cs: repro curl (customer provided):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.2.4-quant","input":"Generate invoice JSON for order 12345","max_tokens":256,"temperature":0.0}'
```

kevin_support: we've got 3 separate tickets from the same customer and 1 internal smoke failure. All reports are ap-sg only — eu/us unaffected. No 5xx or auth/billing errors. latency looks normal.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout: redwood-1.2.4-quant -> ap-sg cluster at 1798500000 (20% traffic) by infra-deploy.

devon_infra: can you paste exact response sample (raw) + whether KV cache was warm? Also need model checksum/hash and batch size. Possible quantization kernel mismatch on A10G — seen small tokenization/packing differences before.

julie_cs: KV cache: warm=true. model sha: a3f9b7d. batch_size: 1. raw response (customer sanitized):
```json
{"invoice_id":"12345","items":[{"desc":"widget","qty":2}],"total":49.99
"company":"NotACME Product Solutions"
```
(note: closing bracket missing, and company field injected)

mike_oncall: I tried to reproduce on ap-sg staging (same image + quant flags). Repro rate ~2/10 with the exact prompt above. When it fails it's always on the last 2-3 tokens (truncation / weird token insert). I routed the failing requests to a fallback model redwood-1.2.3-fp16 and errors dropped to 0/50. Recommend immediate traffic split for affected customers.

devon_infra: agreed. I've put a route rule to send ACME Pay traffic to fallback while we investigate. Need eng-runtime to check kernel selection logs and quant kernel version used for redwood-1.2.4-quant on A10G nodes: /var/log/runtime/kernel-selection.log and /var/log/runtime/kv-cache.log.

eng-runtime: creating ENGRT-4521 to investigate. Assigning to rao and anya. Hypothesis: quantized attention kernel path selected on A10G with CUDA 11.7 leads to off-by-one token packing when sequence length ~ exact prompt boundary. Need reproducible harness with same seed, batch_size=1, temperature=0.0, kv_cache warm/cold toggles.

eng-runtime: also request stacktrace of runtime dispatch for req_0a9c, and the nnpack/kernel fingerprints from that pod. If anyone has the pod id for the failing run, share.

julie_cs: customer approved sharing one failing request and full response for debugging. I'll DM the sample to rao and attach to ENGRT-4521. Marking P2 and CC'ing SRE.

kevin_support: opened a support-incident and notified account team. Will update customer that we're routing them to fallback and investigating; ETA for resolution TBD. :pray:
